Omitted evidence does not dismiss the outstanding question or release help

An explicitly hypothetical later unhinted answer can clear the two checks
A hinted clarification retains only the helped target for a later check
Repeated delivery of the old answer cannot reopen a resolved clarification
The original state is unchanged by all continuations

proposal.text: Do you mean the reading stays the same, and what effect does your hand have on the bulb?
